BehaviorTree._description: Collect Unshelve Episodes - Right Bag (NPU) for trying faster picks on iq9-1: the same collection into the right bag, not recording, with the pick's SAM3 on the Hexagon NPU, but the carry goes straight to the bag without stopping over both bags (bag_view_pause 0), and only the jello and pudding are re-measured at the pre-grasp (align_at_pre_grasp false; their exemplars.yaml entries keep it on), which saves a SAM3 pass on every other product, and the product is carried without the 2 cm lift-and-weigh grasp check (check_grasp_by_weight false), so a missed grasp is only noticed at the bag, and each approach plan stops after a few solutions instead of searching them all (approach_max_solutions), and in the bag the descent until contact and the retreat over the rim are faster (bag_descent_timing, bag_retreat_timing). It does not stop at the plan-failure or Gentle Bag breakpoints (pause_on_plan_failure, pause_if_gentle_bag_fails); it still stops when the pringles slots are full and hands over to teleop when no carry to the bag plans, and the free-space moves are faster (velocity_scale, acceleration_scale). Needs the aihub/sam3/ export, like the NPU favourite. See design_docs/qualcomm_npu_segmentation.md.
